title: Lookup in a state transition block
statement: Let $M$ be a coded one-work-tape machine and let $q$ be one of its states. For any input read and work-tape read, each either blank, $0$, or $1$, the list of transition actions for $q$ has length $9$, and its entry at index $3r_{\mathrm{in}}+r_{\mathrm{work}}$ is the action prescribed by $M$ for those reads, where the blank, $0$, and $1$ have indices $0$, $1$, and $2$, respectively.
hypotheses_covered: the input read is an optional Boolean symbol
the work-tape read is an optional Boolean symbol
replaced:
For every coded machine $M$, state $q$ of $M$, and pair of reads (an input
symbol and a work symbol, each blank, $0$, or $1$): the list of the nine
actions of $q$ has length $9$, and its entry at the record index of the
read pair (three times the serialization index of the input read plus the
serialization index of the work read) is exactly the action $M$ performs at
$q$ on those reads.
